subject: CS477
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections come from a diverse set of high-quality channels like OpenSecurityTraining2, Mxy, and SolidusCode. The Arabic selections are dominated by two excellent, in-depth series from Ahmed Sallam and Sherif Ezzat, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the core assembly topics.
